title: Parse a number
summary: Gin: Parse a number. Try /double/cat. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: strconv.Atoi turns text into an int or reports an error. Open GET /double/4.

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Parse a number

blocks.text: Atoi successfully parses 4. The handler then returns its doubled value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Always check the parse error before using the number.
